饭桌上，陈阳狼吞虎咽地吃着菜，嘴巴里塞得满满的，对苏子宁竖起了大拇指，含糊不清道：“子宁姐，果然还是你做的菜最好吃。”
苏子宁微微一笑，抬头看着陈阳，水波般的眼眸中满是柔情的关爱，嘴角浮现两个浅浅的酒窝，加上一身旗袍，她就像民`国画报里的女人一样，清丽脱俗，却比那更美。
叶以晴低头扒拉着碗底的饭，眼神不时偷偷观察陈阳，心头暗道：“这小子看起来很普通，为什么能轻松躲过我的背后攻击，还反过来将我控制？他功夫这么好，一定有古怪。”
“以晴。”
叶以晴一边想着，有些出神，双眼直直的盯着陈阳，陈阳突然叫了她一声，把她吓得手腕一抖，连忙收回目光，装模作样地吃东西，却发现碗里已经空了。
气氛，顿时有些尴尬。
陈阳挑了挑眉毛，笑道：“你不吃饭，一直盯着我干嘛？我告诉你，我可不喜欢暴力的女人。”
“你……哼，我看在子宁姐的面子上，不跟你计较。”叶以晴瞪着双眼，气得直哼哼。
苏子宁白了陈阳一眼，示意陈阳别挤兑叶以晴。
就在这时，嘀嘀嘀的电话声音响起，陈阳摸出了一个老款的黑白屏诺基亚手机，看着上面的号码，他皱了下眉头，转身朝着饭厅外面走去：“我接个电话，马上回来。”
叶以晴看着陈阳放在耳边的手机，心头分析道：“都什么年代了，竟然还用诺基亚，而且是黑白屏，看来他的经济条件很糟糕。”
陈阳站在院子里，接通了电话，有些不耐烦道：“喂，老李，行行行，叫你师傅。我现在继承爷爷的四合院，正悠闲着，你可别给我这个退休工人再下发什么任务，我告诉你，我绝对不接。”
“不行，就算帮忙也不行，别说师命不可违，我可不吃你这套，我这个人是有原则的，既然退休，就绝不复出。”
“什么，清纯！美女！大学生！”
陈阳双眼放光，随即语调一变，一本正经道：“师傅，虽然我现在退休，但我深深记得你对我的恩情，既然是你好友的孙女，我当然愿意牺牲我的休息时间，帮你这个忙。哎，谁让我这人心软呢，什么，原则，我这人连节操都没有，还有原则？你赶紧把那女孩的信息发过来。”
说完，陈阳挂了电话，把手机从耳边移开，按下手机顶端的天线，手机屏幕上方映射出一块八寸见方的全彩3D虚拟影像，上面显示着一个女孩的个人资料，以及对陈阳的安排。
林柔，十八岁，东安工大计算机学院计算机科学与技术专业大一学生……
看完资料，见没有照片，陈阳皱了下眉头：“没有照片，难道是个丑女，老李不会坑我吧。算了，反正明天就去插班，万一林柔是个恐龙，我就立马溜走。如果是美女的话，我只能牺牲小我，完成大我了。”
打定主意，陈阳心情倍儿棒，其实回到东安市，他还真怕自己闲着，现在能进东安大学玩，总比整天呆在四合院无聊好。而且他没上过大学，对大学生活还挺有几分期待，尤其是听战友说过，大学里面清纯的女孩子特别多，一个赛一个的水灵。
“子宁姐，我这卡里有点钱，密码是你的生日，你拿去安排人把四合院修缮一下。”

回到饭厅，陈阳摸出一张银行卡放在了苏子宁跟前，转身朝着外面走去，道：“这么久没回东安，我出去逛逛。”
没等苏子宁和叶以晴反应过来，陈阳已经走出了四合院的大门，两人大眼瞪小眼，然后目光落在了银行卡上。
她们住的这座四合院很大，占地几百平米，足足有三进，传承了上百年，算得上是文物了。如果要在保留原貌的基础上修缮，至少需要五十万以上，只多不少。
叶以晴眼珠转动，心里分析道：“陈阳连手机都还用的黑白屏诺基亚，他的经济条件显然很拮据，他说这张卡有‘点’钱，我看顶多也就几千。不过他竟然用子宁姐的生日做密码，倒是有些蹊跷。”
一边想着，叶以晴抓起放在桌旁的警帽，起身朝外走去：“子宁姐，今晚我有任务，先走了。”
等叶以晴出了饭厅，苏子宁默默地把银行卡收了起来，苦笑了下，想法和叶以晴一样，也认为卡里没多少钱，她根本没打算用，只当是帮陈阳先保管着。

content_en:
At the dinner table, Chen Yang devoured the food with his mouth full. He gave Su Zining a thumbs up and said vaguely: "Sister Zining, your food is indeed the most delicious."
Su Zining smiled slightly and looked up at Chen Yang, her water-like eyes full of tender care, two shallow dimples appearing at the corners of her mouth, and wearing a cheongsam, she was just like the woman in the Republic of China pictorial, elegant and refined, but even more beautiful than that.
Ye Yiqing lowered her head to pick up the rice at the bottom of the bowl, and secretly observed Chen Yang from time to time. She thought to herself: "This kid looks very ordinary. Why can he easily avoid my attacks from behind and control me in turn? He is so good at martial arts, so there must be something weird about him."
"Yiqing."
Ye Yiqing was thinking, a little lost in thought, staring straight at Chen Yang. Chen Yang suddenly called her, which scared her so much that she shook her wrist. She quickly looked away and pretended to eat, but found that the bowl was empty.
The atmosphere suddenly felt awkward.
Chen Yang raised his eyebrows and said with a smile: "Why are you staring at me without eating? Let me tell you, I don't like violent women."
"You... hum, for the sake of Sister Zining, I won't argue with you." Ye Yiqing stared at her eyes and groaned angrily.
Su Zining rolled her eyes at Chen Yang and signaled Chen Yang not to run against Ye Yiqing.
At this moment, the beeping sound of the phone rang. Chen Yang took out an old black and white Nokia mobile phone. Looking at the number on it, he frowned, turned and walked out of the dining room: "I'll answer the call and I'll be right back."
Ye Yiqing looked at the mobile phone that Chen Yang put to his ear and analyzed in her mind: "What age is it? It's still a Nokia, and it has a black and white screen. It seems that his economic conditions are very bad."
Chen Yang stood in the yard, answered the phone, and said impatiently: "Hey, Lao Li, ok, ok, ok, let's call you master. I'm inheriting my grandpa's courtyard now, and I'm leisurely. Don't give me, a retired worker, any more tasks. I'm telling you, I will never accept it."
"No, even if you help me, I won't do it. Don't say that the teacher's orders are against the law. I won't accept your trick. I am a principled person. Now that I have retired, I will never come back."
"What, pure! Beauty! College student!"
Chen Yang's eyes lit up, and then his tone changed, and he said seriously: "Master, although I am retired now, I deeply remember your kindness to me. Since I am the granddaughter of your good friend, of course I am willing to sacrifice my rest time to help you. Hey, who makes me soft-hearted? What, principles, I don't even have moral integrity, and principles? Please send the girl's information quickly."
After saying that, Chen Yang hung up the phone, moved the phone away from his ear, and pressed the antenna on the top of the phone. An eight-inch square full-color 3D virtual image was mapped on the top of the phone screen, which displayed a girl's personal information and arrangements for Chen Yang.
Lin Rou, 18 years old, is a freshman majoring in computer science and technology at the School of Computer Science at Dong'an University of Technology...
After reading the information and seeing that there were no photos, Chen Yang frowned: "There are no photos. Could it be that she is an ugly girl? Lao Li will not trick me. Forget it, I will join the class tomorrow anyway. If Lin Rou is a dinosaur, I will run away immediately. If it is a beauty, I can only sacrifice my small self to complete my big self."
Having made up his mind, Chen Yang was in a great mood. In fact, when he returned to Dong'an City, he was really afraid that he would be idle. It was better to be able to go to Dong'an University now than to stay bored in the courtyard all day. Moreover, he has never been to college, so he is quite looking forward to college life, especially after hearing from his comrades that there are many pure girls in college, and they are all very good at competing with each other.
"Sister Zining, I have some money in this card. The password is your birthday. You can use it to arrange for someone to repair the courtyard."
Back in the dining room, Chen Yang took out a bank card and placed it in front of Su Zining, turned around and walked outside, saying: "SoI haven’t been back to Dong’an for a long time, so I went out for a walk. "
Before Su Zining and Ye Yiqing could react, Chen Yang had already walked out of the courtyard door. The two stared at each other, and then their eyes fell on the bank card.
The courtyard they live in is very large, covering an area of several hundred square meters, with three entrances. It has been passed down for hundreds of years and can be considered a cultural relic. If it were to be renovated while retaining its original appearance, it would cost at least half a million yuan, but not much more.
Ye Yiqing rolled his eyes and analyzed in his mind: "Chen Yang even uses a black-and-white Nokia cell phone. His financial conditions are obviously very tight. He said that this card has 'a little' money, but I think it is only a few thousand at most. However, it was a bit strange that he actually used Sister Zining's birthday as the password. "
While thinking about it, Ye Yiqing grabbed the police hat placed beside the table, stood up and walked out: "Sister Zining, I have a mission tonight, so I'll leave first. "
When Ye Yiqing left the dining room, Su Zining silently put away the bank card and smiled bitterly. She had the same idea as Ye Yiqing. She also thought that there was not much money in the card and she had no intention of using it. She only thought of it as keeping it for Chen Yang.
